page.layout: One column of running text on the left-centre of the page; a column of marginal quotation marks ("«") runs down the right margin beside each line; running head at top, page number at top right; catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.p: quid recte facturus, aut cōce dendū effe factū defenditur, cū est facti subiecta ratio, sicut ab Opimio, Iure feci, salutis omniū & Reip. conseruāde causa: relatūq; est à Decio, Nesceleratissimū quidem ciuem sine iudicio iure ullo necare potuisti: oritur illa disceptatio, potuerit'ne recte salutis Reip. causa ciuem, euersorem ciuitatis, indemnatū necare. Ita disceptationes eæ quę in iis controuersiis oriūtur, quæ sunt certis personis & tęporibus notatę, fiūtrur fus infinitæ: detractisq; temporibus & personis, rursum ad confultationis formam ra

page.notes: The right margin carries a repeated printed quotation mark ("«") beside each line; these are marginal marks, not words, and are not transcribed individually. Running head read with doubt: letters IVRISCONSVLTVS, partly worn. Line "Nefceleratifsimū" read as "Nefceleratissimū" (long s set as s). The word "ratio" is broken at the foot of the page and continues as "tio-" on the next page; the catchword is given as printed. Several i/j forms (e.g. "ijs", "controuersijs") were normalised to vowel i and consonant j per the rules.
